package.name: whill_safety
package.description:
Runtime safety layer for the WHILL chair (M6-R). Provides `m6r_bringup_launch.py`, the single-command bringup that composes sensors + WHILL driver + M4-R EKF + the runtime scan-to-map localizer (`lidar_localization_ros2`) into the REP-105 TF chain `map -> odom -> base_link -> {imu_link, velodyne, camera_link}`.
M6R-3 will extend this package with the failsafe node (3-layer subscription to `/reinitialization_requested`, `/alignment_status`, `/pcl_pose`) and a `twist_mux`-based `/cmd_vel_safety` gate. That work is deliberately staged inside this same package so the safety concerns (failsafe, mux, physical E-stop hookup, remote-stop hookup at M9) live in one place; see docs/ja/plans/2026-06-24-m6r-localization.md §3.B.
Mutually exclusive with `whill_localization/launch/ odom_bringup_launch.py` — starting both in parallel would compete over `odom -> base_link`. The M6-R plan supersedes that launch; keep it around for M4-R-only debugging only.
